caption: A park bench stands beside a wall at dusk as the streetlights come on, and a shadow of the bench appears on the wall away from the nearest light.

sa.check: A park bench stands beside a wall at dusk.
A shadow of the bench appears on the wall, away from the nearest light.
The shadow appears only when the lights come on.

pc.expect: The shadow appears only when the lights come on and points away from the lamp that lit up.
pc.fail: It is there before the lights; or it points toward the lamp; or the lights come on and no shadow appears.

pc.expect: The shadow keeps the bench's outline, slats and legs.
pc.fail: It is a different shape; or splits under one lamp; or it is a plain blob.

pc.expect: The shadow does not move with the bench and lamp fixed.
pc.fail: It drifts across the wall; or swings round; or changes length.

pc.expect: The shadow is attached at the bench's legs and lies on the wall and ground behind it.
pc.fail: It floats detached; or appears on the lamp side; or it is missing with the lamp on.

pc.expect: One bench and one shadow per lamp.
pc.fail: The bench duplicates or vanishes; or the shadow becomes solid; or the bench passes through the wall.

pc.expect: The bench and the wall stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The bench changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the wall changes.
